ColonyCouncil.ColonyTraitDef.label: green-fingered
ColonyCouncil.ColonyTraitDef.description: The colony lives off its fields, and anyone passing can see it: rows sown straight, nothing left to rot, something always growing.
ColonyCouncil.ColonyTraitDef.earned: The fields have been full for a season now, and travelers have started to say it: the colony is green-fingered. The growers walk a little taller for it.
ColonyCouncil.ColonyTraitDef.lost: The fields have gone quiet, and people have stopped calling the colony green-fingered.

ColonyCouncil.ColonyTraitDef.label: builders
ColonyCouncil.ColonyTraitDef.description: Something is always going up here: a wall, a roof, a new room. The colony is known for building, and building well.
ColonyCouncil.ColonyTraitDef.earned: The colony has hardly stopped building since it began, and it shows. People have started calling it a colony of builders, and the ones who did the building are proud of it.
ColonyCouncil.ColonyTraitDef.lost: The hammers have gone quiet, and nobody calls the colony a colony of builders any more.

ColonyCouncil.ColonyTraitDef.label: learned
ColonyCouncil.ColonyTraitDef.description: There is always a lamp burning over a research bench. The colony is known as a place that wants to understand things.
ColonyCouncil.ColonyTraitDef.earned: The colony has studied more in the last season than most settlements do in years, and word of it has got around: people call it learned. Its thinkers are quietly delighted.
ColonyCouncil.ColonyTraitDef.lost: The research benches have gathered dust, and people have stopped calling the colony learned.

ColonyCouncil.ColonyTraitDef.label: craftsfolk
ColonyCouncil.ColonyTraitDef.description: The workbenches are never cold. The colony is known for the things it makes: clothes, tools, furniture and more besides.
ColonyCouncil.ColonyTraitDef.earned: Things made here have started turning up in traders' packs, and the colony has a name for it now: craftsfolk. Its makers are proud to hear it.
ColonyCouncil.ColonyTraitDef.lost: The workbenches have gone cold, and people no longer speak of the colony's craftsfolk.

ColonyCouncil.ColonyTraitDef.label: hunters
ColonyCouncil.ColonyTraitDef.description: The colony lives off the land around it, and its hunters bring home more game than most. It is known for it.
ColonyCouncil.ColonyTraitDef.earned: Game has been hanging in the colony's cold store all season, and people have started to call it a colony of hunters. The best shots take it as a compliment.
ColonyCouncil.ColonyTraitDef.lost: The hunting has fallen off, and nobody calls the colony a colony of hunters any more.

ColonyCouncil.ColonyTraitDef.label: delvers
ColonyCouncil.ColonyTraitDef.description: The colony digs: into the hills, down after ore, through rock other settlers go around. It is known for it.
ColonyCouncil.ColonyTraitDef.earned: The colony has dug through more rock this season than some settlements see in a lifetime, and people have started calling it a colony of delvers. Its miners are proud of every tunnel.
ColonyCouncil.ColonyTraitDef.lost: The digging has stopped, and people have stopped calling the colony a colony of delvers.
